children: Tokyo, September 14, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has affirmed the Baa1 issuer rating and Baa1 senior unsecured shelf rating of Kirin Holdings Company, Limited.  "The affirmation of Kirin's Baa1 rating reflects its strong market positions in alcoholic beverages and its stable cash flow," says Chiaki Yamamoto, a Moody's Ratings Vice President- Ratings.

title: Moody's Ratings affirms Kirin's Baa1 ratings; outlook stable
